_note: Rates transcribed from DeepSeek's published pricing page at the retrieved_at instant. DeepSeek quotes a PEAK and an OFF-PEAK rate (off-peak is half of peak; peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri). The `input`/`output`/`cache_read` fields carry the PEAK figures deliberately: a cost gate that understates spend is worse than one that overstates it, so the shipped number is an upper bound. Both figures are kept per model under `peak`/`off_peak` so the discount can be applied later without re-fetching. `input` is the CACHE-MISS rate and `cache_read` the cache-hit rate; canary_cost charges (input_tokens - cache_read_tokens) at `input` and cache_read_tokens at `cache_read`, because DeepSeek reports cache hits as a breakdown OF prompt_tokens and not as an extra bucket (see core/turn_observations._usage_from_token_usage). NEVER edit a published version in place: historical runs must stay reproducible. Add a v3 instead.
